Name: Intro Funeral March
Author: Seelenamt
Description:
To install:
﻿You will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043]Platonymous' Custom Music Mod[/url]﻿ (which itself depends on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] mod)

﻿I highly recommend using it with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11789]Worse Dying Grandpa[/url] mod for the full, intended experience. This mod was made with it in mind, though you can ﻿technically use this without it.

﻿Drag and drop the "[CM] Intro Funeral March" into your mods folder once you have those installed and it should work.


The song starts out quiet, so bear that in mind. It is Chopin's Funeral March from the YouTube audio library.

This replaces Grandpa's Theme entirely, so it will also play during the 3rd year cutscene.

Downloads.Description: Just drag and drop into the mods folder once you've downloaded the required mods.
